content.text:
`npm start` crashes because `DATABASE_URL` has the wrong scheme. I haven't fixed it, because the fix is a change to a secret value.

- `src/server.js:7` requires `DATABASE_URL` to start with `postgres://` or `postgresql://`. If it doesn't, the server logs "bad DATABASE_URL" and exits.
- `npm run doctor` checks the same pattern and reports "DATABASE_URL has the wrong scheme".
- The value comes from the `shared` accio/Fidelius profile and is concealed from agent output. I can't see what it is now. It might use `mysql://` or `postgres:/` (one slash), or be empty, quoted or have leading whitespace.

The error message suggests rerunning with `accio shared --no-mask`. I didn't, because that would print your secrets, and you've set them to be hidden from agents.

To fix it, open the `DATABASE_URL` entry in the `shared` profile in Fidelius and change it to the form `postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname`. Then run `npm run doctor`, which should print "all good", and `npm start`.

If you'd rather I look at the value, you can switch off "Hide in agent output" for `DATABASE_URL` in Fidelius, or paste just the scheme prefix here. I don't think the code needs any change.
